config.label: Khipu v3 API key (sent as x-api-key header)
config.description: Khipu v3 API key (sent as x-api-key header). Obtain from Khipu merchant panel → Developers.

config.label: Khipu receiver id (merchant id)
config.description: Khipu receiver id (merchant id). Required only for legacy v2 HTTP Basic auth; not needed when KHIPU_API_KEY is set.

config.label: Khipu receiver secret
config.description: Khipu receiver secret. Required only for legacy v2 HTTP Basic auth; not needed when KHIPU_API_KEY is set.

config.label: Khipu API base URL
config.description: Khipu API base URL. Defaults to https://payment-api.khipu.com/v3.
